root_cause: BackdropFilter carried only a blur and an optional matrix through WidgetKind/RenderKind/LayerKind/PaintCommand, and the WGPU backdrop path had only Blur and Matrix ops, so colour filters and compositions were refused at construction.
change: incular-rendering: LayerKind::BackdropFilter and PaintCommand::PushBackdropFilter gain image_filter: Option<ImageFilter> (supersedes blur/matrix when set); LayerTree::update_backdrop_image_filter; backdrop_stage_is_active and backdrop_image_filter_executable (backdrop.rs); cache-key hashing image_filter_generation (compositor.rs). incular-wgpu: BackdropOp::Chain of BackdropStage {Blur, Matrix, Color} over a full-target capture, executed stage by stage with the existing blur encoder, affine resample and colour-matrix pass (renderer/backdrop.rs); unsupported_effect reports dilate/erode stages; composition bounds grow by the chain's summed blur sigma. incular-widgets: WidgetKind/RenderKind::BackdropFilter.image_filter threaded through lowering, layers, the compositor-only update and descriptor eq/debug; BackdropFilter::image_filter accepts blur, matrix, colour and compositions (single blur/matrix keep the fast paths) and refuses only dilate/erode.
harness: no frame scenario; pixel scenes not run (run-pixels.sh excluded)
api_change: additive: PaintCommand::PushBackdropFilter and LayerKind::BackdropFilter gain an image_filter field (struct literals must add image_filter: None); BackdropFilter::image_filter now accepts colour and composed filters
limitations: Dilate and erode still have no backdrop pass (UnsupportedBackdropFilter / UnsupportedImageFilter). A chain runs every stage over the whole target (no clip-sized coverage optimisation). A singular matrix anywhere in a chain drops the whole stage (backdrop shows through), as the single-matrix path already did. Not verified on GPU end to end (no headless renderer harness); the passes it runs are the existing tested ones.

root_cause: The compositor transform layer held only a matrix and Transform/MatrixTransition/ScaleTransition/RotationTransition had no filterQuality, so a transformed child was always drawn through the transform instead of rasterized and resampled (Flutter RenderTransform pushes ImageFilterLayer(ImageFilter.matrix(transform, filterQuality))).
change: incular-rendering: LayerKind::Transform gains sampling: Option<ImageSampling>, LayerTree::update_transform_sampling; flatten emits a new PaintCommand::PushMatrixFilter {matrix, stage, sampling, bounds, filtered_bounds} with the child flattened untransformed (compositor.rs, display_list.rs). incular-wgpu: renderer/matrix_filter.rs renders the child into the layer's retained source and resamples it through S*W*M^-1*W^-1*S^-1 into the effect cache (cached on source generation, map and size), composited as a Filtered batch; resample_shader.wgsl mode 4 = nearest (FilterQuality.none), mode 2 bilinear; counter matrix_filter_passes. incular-widgets: filter_quality on WidgetKind/RenderKind Transform, Scale, Rotation; Transform::filter_quality, MatrixTransition::filter_quality (applied only while animation.is_animating, as Flutter), ScaleTransition/RotationTransition::filter_quality (applied only while the controller is active); layer creation, update_from_kind and the compositor-only update set the sampling.
api_change: additive: new PaintCommand::PushMatrixFilter variant (exhaustive matches must add it; updated in incular-wgpu, incular-runtime/tests/runtime.rs and incular-widgets/tests/common/mod.rs); LayerKind::Transform gains sampling (patterns need ..); new builders Transform/MatrixTransition/ScaleTransition/RotationTransition::filter_quality(FilterQuality)
limitations: ImageSampling has only Linear and Nearest, so Medium and High resample bilinearly (no mipmaps or bicubic). Alignment pivots are fractional translations around the filtered transform, so only the core matrix is resampled. The source is the child's full bounds and the result is clipped to the target. ImageFiltered with ImageFilter.matrix still lowers to a vector Transform (Flutter defaults that filter to FilterQuality.low).

root_cause: Force press: the runtime dropped the pointer sample (pressure) when it converted a metadata-rich pointer to the gesture-dispatch PointerEvent, and GestureDetector had no force-press callbacks or arena member, so ForcePressGestureRecognizer was built nowhere. (Tap move, long-press down and cancel were fixed by gestures-api.)
change: incular-core/incular-platform/incular-desktop already carry NormalizedPressure (winit Touch force normalized by max_possible_force), so no change there. incular-runtime/src/frame.rs passes the sample to the new WidgetTree::dispatch_pointer_gesture_with_hit_sample. incular-widgets tree/interaction.rs: RetainedGestureKind::ForcePress members (tree.rs ForcePressMember: ArenaGestureRecognizer<ForcePressGestureRecognizer> + local transform) join the arena on primary presses that report pressure, observe every event with its sample and local position, accept/reject through the shared arena, take sole-press acceptance, and are cancelled on arena loss. incular-gestures: GestureCallbacks.on_force_press_start/peak/update/end, has_force_press, force_press_recognizer; force_press.rs defers the starting event's peak/update until a later external acceptance so onStart comes first, as Flutter's closed arena does. GestureDetector::on_force_press_* builders; ForcePressDetails re-exported.
tests: crates/incular-widgets/tests/force_press.rs (4 tests: start/peak/update/end order; no-pressure device never force presses and still taps; a started force press beats the tap; a light press lets the tap win)
api_change: additive: GestureCallbacks gains four force-press fields (literals need ..Default::default()); WidgetTree::dispatch_pointer_gesture_with_hit_sample; GestureDetector::on_force_press_start/peak/update/end
limitations: Pressure is normalized by the adapters, so pressure_min/pressure_max are 0 and 1 by contract and were not added as separate fields. A device that reports normalized pressure participates even where Flutter would see pressureMax <= 1 (e.g. Android touchscreens) and reject. No harness scenario (the recorder has no pressure input).
note: Supersedes the deferred/blocked force-press parts of gestures-api and paint-2.
